name: loka-wikidata-v6
notes: BPE-tokenized round (50K vocab). Same architecture as v5 (d_model 512, 6 layers, 44M params), trained 5 epochs on the 757k-triple Wikidata slice with the BPE tokenizer added in 8252f13. Final epoch-5 perplexity 194.98 — not directly comparable to v5's 84.85 because BPE has more tokens per role (more mass to predict per position). The point of v6 is qualitative: tokenizer now handles unicode names like 'Saint-Léger' and 'Wikipédia' as proper subword pieces instead of dropping accents. Tag is `v6-bpe` (not `v6`) because an empty `v6` tag was created by an earlier upload run before v6.pt existed; the newer upload uses a fresh tag rather than rewriting the existing one. The vocab pinned here is the BPE vocab; the BPE tokenizer JSON is also pinned so inference scripts can resolve it via `loader._resolve('tokenizer_bpe')`.
